mapper.select: select d.detail_id, d.notice_id, d.sales_detail_id, d.warehouse_id, warehouse_dept.dept_name as warehouse_name, d.item_type, d.item_id, d.item_code, d.item_name, d.product_id, d.product_name, d.notice_qty, d.delivered_qty, d.delivered_cost_amount from inv_delivery_notice_detail d left join sys_dept warehouse_dept on warehouse_dept.dept_id = d.warehouse_id where d.notice_id = #{noticeId} order by d.detail_id asc
mapper.insert:
insert into inv_delivery_notice_detail ( notice_id, sales_detail_id, item_type, item_id, item_code, item_name, product_id, product_name, notice_qty, delivered_qty, delivered_cost_amount, warehouse_id ) values
(#{item.noticeId}, #{item.salesDetailId}, coalesce(#{item.itemType}, 'product'), coalesce(#{item.itemId}, #{item.productId}), #{item.itemCode}, #{item.itemName}, #{item.productId}, #{item.productName}, #{item.noticeQty}, #{item.deliveredQty}, #{item.deliveredCostAmount}, #{item.warehouseId})
